subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw permanently own and bundle this Claude harness and its bridge package, or should the implementation remain an independently maintained ClawHub plugin using only generic SDK seams?
rationale: The choice determines package trust, credential ownership, persistent-state architecture, release responsibility, and how much Claude-specific policy may enter core; those are product and security ownership decisions rather than mechanical review fixes.

options.title: Externalize the harness
options.body: Keep or extract only genuinely generic Plugin SDK seams in core and publish the Claude harness and bridge as an independently maintained ClawHub plugin.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled harness
options.body: Accept long-term OpenClaw ownership only after transferring or republishing the bridge, removing quarantine bypasses, moving state to SQLite, and making auth ownership plugin-declared.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Leave the PR and canonical issue paused until a maintainer or security owner can commit to the package, auth, state, and release obligations.

recommendation.title: Externalize the harness
recommendation.body: Keep or extract only genuinely generic Plugin SDK seams in core and publish the Claude harness and bridge as an independently maintained ClawHub plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the central agent-runtime and dependency surfaces, and the decision requires repository-wide product and release ownership.
